kpis.description_fr: Production électrique Nordic (Suède, Finlande). Hero KPI post-divestment Russie 2022. Hydro + nucléaire >95% sans CO2.
kpis.description_en: Nordic power generation (Sweden, Finland). Post-Russia divestment hero KPI 2022. Hydro + nuclear >95% CO2-free.

kpis.description_fr: Capacité hydroélectrique Nordic. Actif structurel irremplaçable (concessions long terme Suède/Finlande).
kpis.description_en: Nordic hydropower capacity. Irreplaceable structural asset (long-term Sweden/Finland concessions).

kpis.description_fr: Capacité nucléaire (Loviisa direct + parts OL3 Olkiluoto/Forsmark/Oskarshamn). Baseload bas carbone Nordic.
kpis.description_en: Nuclear capacity (Loviisa direct + OL3 Olkiluoto/Forsmark/Oskarshamn shares). Nordic low-carbon baseload.

kpis.description_fr: EBITDA comparable post-Uniper. Volatilité tirée par prix électricité Nordic spot et hedging.
kpis.description_en: Comparable EBITDA post-Uniper. Volatility driven by Nordic spot power prices and hedging.

kpis.description_fr: Part de la production sans CO2 (hydro + nucléaire). Niveau structurel ~95% post-Uniper, parmi les plus élevés européens.
kpis.description_en: Share of CO2-free generation (hydro + nuclear). Structural ~95% post-Uniper, among the highest in Europe.
